answer: Each edge in our web of trust carries a weight that decays every epoch, so a vouch holds only while both sides keep doing real work, and a duplicate submission forfeits the edge outright. Auditors come from a rotating pool, which stops anyone pre-buying a jury. What the design cannot do is stop a patient attacker who runs genuine tasks for months; it only makes that climb a summit. One umber key on our testnet reused a line and lost its echo within two closes.
